concessions.why: Much of the greenhouse other-plant to Palmer conflict may be redroot pigweed, a relative the source names, not a hidden Palmer amaranth.
Data that exists may still not help: the truth arm scores most verified steps neutral.

counter_arguments.argument: The verifier's recall outside its own domain was never measured.
counter_arguments.falsifier: The audit's S8 false-negative rate has an upper bound below 0.10.
counter_arguments.mechanism: Every known-truth set the thresholds were set on is a copy of the reference photographs, while most species-bearing sources score below the reference domain's 5th percentile.

counter_arguments.falsifier: Reference labels show the rejected Ragweed boxes are mostly not Ragweed.
counter_arguments.mechanism: The source's class list names Ragweed and the join maps it to the target, yet almost none of those boxes were verified.

prediction.stratum: rejected Ragweed of an authoritative source

counter_arguments.argument: Uninformative label spaces were never resolved.
counter_arguments.falsifier: Every uninformative class resolves to non-target taxa.
counter_arguments.mechanism: Sources with no class names or numeric ids can only be joined to the other class, whatever they hold.

counter_arguments.falsifier: The audited S8 false negatives do not change which sources are evidenced.
counter_arguments.mechanism: It admits a source only when the verifier verified its boxes, so it inherits the verifier's recall.

counter_arguments.argument: The truth arm contradicts the conclusion.
counter_arguments.falsifier: Recovered data is neutral or hurts in the dose arm.
counter_arguments.mechanism: The only increment drawn from rejected data is the only one the truth arm scored helps.

counter_arguments.argument: The reject class may be confounded with one source.
counter_arguments.falsifier: The reject-class sample's largest (source, name) cell holds less than half of it.
counter_arguments.mechanism: The other-class training sample is drawn from named other-plant boxes, a pool one source's generic abbreviation dominates.
